title: Tax Office Shares a Thanksgiving Message of Gratitude
excerpt: Webb County Tax Assessor-Collector Patricia A. Barrera shared a Thanksgiving message Wednesday, calling on residents to use their blessings to drive positive change and uplift those around them.
content:
Webb County Tax Assessor-Collector Patricia A. Barrera shared a Thanksgiving message with residents on Wednesday, Nov. 25, wishing Webb County families a holiday filled with hope and joy.

In the message, posted by the Webb County Tax Office, Barrera said true gratitude is about using our blessings to drive positive change and uplift those around us, and she shared the words, "Gratitude turns what we have into enough."

She closed the message with warmest wishes from her family to yours for Thanksgiving.

Sources: Webb County Tax Office, Nov. 25, 2026.
